formal_bound.formula: epsilon_total <= epsilon_Ed25519 + epsilon_ML-DSA-44 + epsilon_encoding + epsilon_binding + epsilon_key_lifecycle
formal_bound.epsilon_Ed25519: forgery advantage of Ed25519 under the selected security model
formal_bound.epsilon_ML-DSA-44: forgery advantage of ML-DSA-44 under the selected security model
formal_bound.epsilon_encoding: probability that two accepted semantic envelopes have the same canonical encoding
formal_bound.epsilon_binding: probability that a valid signature transfers across context, key_id, nonce, policy, or version
formal_bound.epsilon_key_lifecycle: probability of accepting a revoked or compromised key
formal_bound.composition: AND verification rejects unless both component signatures and lifecycle checks pass

statistics.effect_size_definition: Cohen's d; sample statistics include mean, median, stdev, IQR and 95% CI

seed_scope: seed controls generated benchmark payload bytes; cryptographic keys and nonces use the OS CSPRNG
